content.comment_body: After 5 years since its phase-out date, the [product_name] [article_no] and associated accessories have officially reached final discontinuation as of September 30, 2021. These items are now unavailable for spare parts and cannot be repaired. The advised replacement is the latest [product_name] [version_no], but please keep in mind that older expansion modules and memory cards will not work with this new version. The relevant article is currently provided only in German, since the website's language selection is not functional.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are informed that the [product_name] [article_no] and accessories have been discontinued, meaning spare parts and repairs are no longer possible. The suggested alternative is [product_name] [version_no], although certain accessories, such as expansion modules and memory cards, lack compatibility with the updated version. Access to official details is limited, as the discontinuation notice is provided solely in German due to website language issues.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope for continued access to spare parts and repair services for [product_name] [article_no], compatibility with already owned expansion modules and memory cards for future models, and support articles available in different languages.
